national_news.title: 80th Independence Day Celebrations to Highlight Yuva Shakti and 150 Years of Vande Mataram
bullets: The 80th Independence Day celebrations will be led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi from the historic Red Fort.
The Prime Minister will unfurl the National Flag and address the nation.
The celebrations will commemorate 150 years of the National Song, Vande Mataram.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill to recognise digital banking records as legal evidence
bullets: The Bill aims to modernise the legal framework to meet the requirements of the present banking system.
It seeks to provide a law relating to evidence with respect to bankers’ books and align it with contemporary digital banking practices.
The Bill makes electronic or digital records of a banker’s book admissible as legal evidence.

national_news.title: Lok Sabha passes Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 to improve transparency & efficiency of Tribunals
bullets: The Bill aims to improve efficiency, ensure independence, transparency, and uniformity in the qualifications, appointment of service of Chairpersons and Members
The Lok Sabha passed the Bill without discussion amidst opposition uproar
The Bill aims to reform the functioning of Tribunals in India

national_news.title: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju appeals to opposition to allow HM Amit Shah to make statement
bullets: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju assured that Home Minister Amit Shah is ready to respond to every point regarding recent student protests.
The Government is ready for a detailed discussion in Parliament regarding the student protests and related issues.
Kiren Rijiju urged the Opposition to maintain order on the floor and refrain from further obstructing proceedings.

national_news.title: India's Asiatic Lion Population Thrives with Conservation Efforts
bullets: India's Asiatic lion population has increased from 523 to 891 in the last 10 years.
The government's conservation efforts, backed by community participation, have led to the expansion of the lions' habitat and range.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the success of India's conservation journey on World Lion Day.

national_news.title: Dr. Jitendra Singh calls for enhancing private sector participation in India's biotech ecosystem
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh emphasized the need for stronger linkages between India's indigenous biotechnology capabilities, industry, and investors.
The goal is to promote indigenous products and technologies in biotechnology and life sciences, and to commercialize innovations at a faster pace.
The Minister called for enhancing private sector participation in India's biotech ecosystem to strengthen industry outreach.

national_news.title: Indonesia battles wildfires across 107,000 hectares
bullets: Wildfires have burned over 107,000 hectares in Indonesia.
The largest fire is in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park in East Java, scorching 743 hectares.
Cloud-seeding operations are unlikely due to the dry season.

national_news.title: Iran's FM Spokesperson: Strait of Hormuz Won't Reopen Till US Naval Blockade Continues
bullets: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei stated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the US naval blockade continues.
The closure of the Strait of Hormuz is attributed to US and Israeli military aggression against Iran, according to Baqaei.
The reopening of the waterway relies on conditions enforced by the US and Israeli authorities on Iran and the Strait of Hormuz.

national_news.title: Typhoon Dolphin Batters Eastern China, Over 1 Million Evacuated
bullets: China issued its highest-level red alert for Typhoon Dolphin, the strongest storm to hit the country this year.
Over 1 million people were evacuated from eastern China, including Shanghai, as the typhoon made landfall.
Heavy rain and disrupted transport were reported across the region, with nearly 1,000 flights cancelled in Shanghai.

national_news.title: Hockey World Cup to be played in new format; quarterfinal stage scrapped
bullets: The FIH Hockey Men's and Women's World Cup 2026 will feature a revamped competition structure.
The traditional quarterfinal stage has been scrapped, and the top two teams from each of the two crossover pools will advance directly to the semi-finals.
The tournament will be hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands from August 15 to 30.

national_news.title: India wins two medals at World Athletics U20 Championships in US
bullets: Basant Kumar Meghwal won silver in the men's high jump with a personal best clearance of 2.21 metres.
Shahnavaz Khan claimed bronze in the men's long jump with a best effort of 7.84 metres.
This is the first time Indians have won medals in the high jump and long jump at the championships.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill to enhance ease of doing business
bullets: The Bill seeks to amend the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, the Income-tax Act, 2025, and the Finance Act, 2026.
The bill will replace the Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026, which was promulgated on 5th June this year.
The Ordinance was promulgated with the objective of mitigating the impact of external economic shocks.

national_news.title: TRAI directs use of 1601 series for transactional and service calls
bullets: TRAI issued Direction on use of 1601 series numbers for transactional and service calls by entities in sectors other than BFSI and Government.
Implementation will be done in phases for Utilities, Courier and Logistics sectors entities.
Entities include electricity distribution companies, water utilities, city gas distribution companies, and LPG distribution entities.

national_news.title: Government Schemes for Indian Citizens
bullets: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment is involved in designing various government schemes.
These schemes aim to enhance social welfare, economic development, health, and education for Indian citizens.
Eligibility, application processes, and benefits of each scheme are provided for citizens to take advantage of.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Appoints Officials for Various Posts
bullets: Bihar government has appointed officials for various posts, including Lok Sanchalak (JANKARI 2.0 RTI Portal) and nodal officers for fire safety and ERP & Biometric System.
The appointments were made through separate orders/circulars/notification dated 31/07/2026, 28/07/2026, and 24/07/2026.
These appointments are aimed at improving governance and public services in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Governor Attends Dr. Arvind Panagariya's Lecture Program at Bihar Lok Bhawan
bullets: Bihar Governor participated in a special lecture program at Bihar Lok Bhawan.
Chief Minister announced a wide campaign to raise awareness about organ donation.
Efforts will be made to strengthen, improve, and make education system in Bihar more student-centric.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Transfers Rs 1,100 to 1.13 Crore Pensioners on Bihar Pension Day
bullets: 1.13 crore pensioners in Bihar received a one-time transfer of Rs 1,100 each.
The transfer was made on Bihar Pension Day.
The move aims to support the social security of pensioners in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM and Governor extend New Year 2026 wishes to the people of Bihar
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister extended heartfelt New Year wishes to the people of Bihar.
The Governor of Bihar also extended New Year 2026 wishes to the people of Bihar.
The Chief Minister inspected the construction work of Loknayak Jayaprakash Narayan Super Specialty Hospital in Rajvanshi Nagar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Empanels Media Agencies for Advertisements
bullets: Bihar government has empanelled media agencies for advertisements.
The decision aims to include newspapers and magazines in the state government's advertisement list at DAVP rates.
This move is expected to benefit media agencies and promote transparency in government advertising.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM extends New Year greetings to the people of Bihar
bullets: Bihar CM extended New Year greetings to the people of Bihar.
He visited Paras Hospital to inquire about the well-being of former MP Shri Shivananad Tiwari.
The Bihar Governor highlighted the significant contribution of the Marwari community to the state's economy.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Observe Birth Anniversaries of Maharana Pratap and Ashoka
bullets: The Bihar government has decided to observe the birth anniversaries of Maharana Pratap and Ashoka as state functions.
The decision was made to commemorate the birth anniversaries of these two great leaders on May 9 and Chaitra Shukla Ashtami respectively.
The state government will organize official functions to mark these occasions.
